# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 111 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 111

**1** Jesus said: "Heaven and earth will be rolled up right before your eyes — and anyone who is alive through the Living One will not face death." Hasn't Jesus said: "Anyone who finds themselves — the world is unworthy of them?"

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Right before your eyes" — the immediacy of the cosmic event
- "Alive through the Living One" — the participation in divine life
- "The world is unworthy of them" — passive-voice alternative for "not worthy of"
- The meta-question rendered conversationally
